subject: DI04019011

h.en: 1.1.1 Follow heat through one steam pipe
h.gu: 1.1.1 એક Steam Pipeમાં Heatનો રસ્તો જોઈએ

body.en:
Start with the situation

Hot steam heats a pipe wall, the wall loses heat to air, and insulation changes the loss. This one situation contains several heat-transfer mechanisms.

Definition / principle

Heat transfer is energy transfer caused by a temperature difference. Conduction, convection and radiation are mechanisms, not separate substances.

Understand why

Temperature is a state property; heat is energy crossing a boundary. RateQdot is inW; energyQ is inJ; heat fluxqdoubleprime=Qdot/A inW/m².

Application / illustration

A pipe loses heat through internal convection, wall conduction and external convection/radiation in series/parallel combinations.

Common mistake / conditions

Always identify the system, temperature locations, area and steady/transient model before choosing a formula.

Does heat flux have the same unit as heat rate?

No. Heat flux isW/m²; heat rate isW.
body.gu:
પરિસ્થિતિથી શરૂઆત

ગરમ steam pipe wall ગરમ કરે,wall airમાં heat છોડે અને insulation loss બદલે.એક જ પરિસ્થિતિમાં અનેક heat-transfer mechanisms છે.

Definition / Principle

Temperature differenceથી થતું energy transfer એટલે heat transfer.Conduction,convection,radiation mechanisms છે,અલગ પદાર્થો નહિ.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Temperature state property છે;heat boundary પાર જતી energy છે.Rate Qdot Wમાં,energy Q Jમાં,heat flux qdoubleprime=Qdot/A W/m²માં છે.

Application / ઉદાહરણ

Pipeમાં internal convection,wall conduction,external convection/radiation series/parallel combinationsથી loss થાય.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Formula પહેલાં system,temperature locations,area,steady/transient model ઓળખો.

Heat Flux અને Heat Rateના Units Same?

ના.Heat flux W/m²;heat rate Wમાં છે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Conduction transfers energy through microscopic interactions without bulk material motion. Fourier law in one dimension:qdoubleprime=−k dT/dx; Qdot=−kA dT/dx.

Understand why

Thermal conductivityk inW/(m·K) measures the material response; it can depend on temperature, direction and structure. The minus sign indicates heat flows toward lower temperature.

For a steady plane wall, constantk, no generation and one-dimensional flow:Qdot=kA(T1−T2)/L.The wall resistanceR=L/(kA) inK/W.

Common mistake / conditions

A temperature difference in°C equals the same difference inK; absolute radiation temperature must useK.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Bulk material motion વગર microscopic interactionsથી energy transfer conduction છે.One-dimensional Fourier law:qdoubleprime=−k dT/dx;Qdot=−kA dT/dx.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Thermal conductivity k W/(m·K)માં material response બતાવે;temperature,direction,structureથી બદલાય.Minus sign lower temperature તરફ heat flow બતાવે.

Steady plane wall,constant k,no generation,one-dimensional flowમાં Qdot=kA(T1−T2)/L.Wall resistance R=L/(kA),K/Wમાં છે.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Temperature difference°Cમાં જેટલો,Kમાં એટલો;absolute radiation temperature Kમાં જ જોઈએ.

body.en:
Given and model

WallA10m², L.2m, k1.5W/(m·K), faces120°C and40°C; steady conditions for1hour.

Step-by-step solution

  1. R=.2/(1.5×10)=.013333K/W
  2. Qdot=(120−40)/R=6000W=6kW
  3. Q=6000×3600=21.6MJ

Common mistake / conditions

Face temperatures are given; do not add air-film resistances unless bulk-fluid temperatures and convection data are part of the model.

Ifh increases, which resistance falls?

The corresponding convection resistance1/(hA), not automatically the solid-wall resistance.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

Wall A10m²,L.2m,k1.5W/(m·K),faces120°C,40°C;1hour સુધી steady conditions.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. R=.2/(1.5×10)=.013333K/W
  2. Qdot=(120−40)/R=6000W=6kW
  3. Q=6000×3600=21.6MJ

Common Mistake / શરતો

Face temperatures આપેલા છે;bulk-fluid temperatures,convection data હોય ત્યારે જ air-film resistances ઉમેરો.

h વધે તો કયું Resistance ઘટે?

Corresponding convection resistance1/(hA) ઘટે,solid-wall resistance આપમેળે નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

For steady series layers of common area with perfect contact:Rtotal=sumLi/(ki A); Qdot=(Th−Tc)/Rtotal. The same heat rate crosses every layer.

Understand why

Layer temperature drop=Qdot Ri; the largest resistance produces the largest drop. Contact resistance and changing area require additional modelling. Parallel paths add conductances, not series resistances.

Common mistake / conditions

Do not average conductivities arithmetically and pretend every composite behaves like a homogeneous wall.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Common areaના steady series layers,perfect contactમાં Rtotal=sum Li/(ki A);Qdot=(Th−Tc)/Rtotal.દરેક layerમાંથી same heat rate જાય.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Layer temperature drop=Qdot Ri;મોટું resistance મોટો drop આપે.Contact resistance,changing area માટે વધારાનું modelling જોઈએ.Parallel pathsમાં conductances ઉમેરાય,series resistances નહિ.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Conductivitiesની arithmetic average લઈને દરેક compositeને homogeneous wall ન માનો.

body.en:
Given and model

A2m²; layer1 L.1m, k.5W/(m·K); layer2 L.2m, k1; hot face200°C, cold face40°C, perfect contact.

Step-by-step solution

  1. R1=.1/(.5×2)=.1K/W; R2=.2/(1×2)=.1K/W
  2. Qdot=160/.2=800W
  3. Interface temperature=200−800(.1)=120°C

Common mistake / conditions

Check the other side:120−800(.1)=40°C.Heat rate is conserved in this steady no-generation model.

Equal temperature drops prove equal conductivity?

No. They show equal resistance here; length and area also matter.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

A2m²;layer1 L.1m,k.5W/(m·K);layer2 L.2m,k1;hot face200°C,cold face40°C,perfect contact.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. R1=.1/(.5×2)=.1K/W;R2=.2/(1×2)=.1K/W
  2. Qdot=160/.2=800W
  3. Interface temperature=200−800(.1)=120°C

Common Mistake / શરતો

બીજી બાજુ check:120−800(.1)=40°C.આ steady no-generation modelમાં heat rate conserve થાય.

Equal Temperature Drops એટલે Equal Conductivity?

ના.અહીં equal resistance બતાવે;length,area પણ અસર કરે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

For a steady hollow cylinder of lengthL, inner radiusr1, outer radiusr2 and constantk:R=ln(r2/r1)/(2pi kL); Qdot=(T1−T2)/R.

Understand why

Cylindrical area2pi rL increases outward; therefore using a flat-wall area at an arbitrary radius is not the exact cylindrical solution. Composite concentric layers add logarithmic resistances.

Common mistake / conditions

Use natural logarithm and radii in the same units; diameter ratios give the same logarithm but do not mix a radius with a diameter.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Steady hollow cylinderની length L,inner radius r1,outer r2,constant k હોય તો R=ln(r2/r1)/(2pi kL);Qdot=(T1−T2)/R.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Cylindrical area2pi rL બહાર તરફ વધે;એટલે arbitrary radiusના areaથી flat-wall formula exact cylinder solution નથી.Composite concentric layersમાં logarithmic resistances ઉમેરાય.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Natural logarithm,એક જ unitsના radii લો;diameter ratioનો logarithm same મળે,પણ radius,diameter ભેળવો નહિ.

body.en:
Given and model

r1.025m, r2.05m, L2m, k15W/(m·K), inner/outer surface150/80°C.

Step-by-step solution

  1. R=ln(.05/.025)/(2pi×15×2)=.00367726K/W
  2. Qdot=70/R=19035.91W≈19.036kW

Common mistake / conditions

This is surface-to-surface conduction only, not the total loss between steam and ambient air.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

r1.025m,r2.05m,L2m,k15W/(m·K),inner/outer surface150/80°C.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. R=ln(.05/.025)/(2pi×15×2)=.00367726K/W
  2. Qdot=70/R=19035.91W≈19.036kW

Common Mistake / શરતો

આ ફક્ત surface-to-surface conduction છે,steamથી ambient સુધીનો total loss નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Convection combines fluid motion and molecular transfer near a surface. Newton law:Qdot=hA(Ts−Tbulk); film resistanceRconv=1/(hA).

Understand why

Coefficienth inW/(m²·K) depends on flow, geometry, fluid properties and conditions; it is not only a material constant. Natural/free convection arises from buoyancy; forced convection uses a fan, pump or other imposed flow.

Application / illustration

A hot radiator heats room air by free convection; air blown over a cooler uses forced convection. Mixing mechanisms may coexist.

Common mistake / conditions

Ts andTbulk are not interchangeable with two wall-face temperatures.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Convectionમાં fluid motion અને surface નજીક molecular transfer જોડાય.Newton law:Qdot=hA(Ts−Tbulk);film resistance Rconv=1/(hA).

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

h W/(m²·K)માં flow,geometry,fluid properties,conditions પર આધારિત છે;ફક્ત material constant નહિ.Natural/free convection buoyancyથી;forced convection fan,pump કે imposed flowથી થાય.

Application / ઉદાહરણ

Hot radiator room airને free convectionથી ગરમ કરે;cooler પર blown air forced convection છે.Mechanisms સાથે હોઈ શકે.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Ts,Tbulkને બે wall-face temperatures સાથે ન ભેળવો.

body.en:
Given and model

A5m², wallL.1m, k1; hhot100, hcold20W/(m²·K); bulk fluids200/20°C; neglect radiation/contact resistance.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Rhot=.002; Rwall=.020; Rcold=.010K/W
  2. Qdot=180/.032=5625W
  3. Hot wall Ts, h=200−5625(.002)=188.75°C
  4. Cold wall Ts, c=20+5625(.010)=76.25°C

Common mistake / conditions

Check wall drop188.75−76.25=112.5°C=5625(.020).State which temperature belongs to which node.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

A5m²,wall L.1m,k1;hhot100,hcold20W/(m²·K);bulk fluids200/20°C;radiation/contact resistance અવગણો.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. Rhot=.002;Rwall=.020;Rcold=.010K/W
  2. Qdot=180/.032=5625W
  3. Hot wall Ts,h=200−5625(.002)=188.75°C
  4. Cold wall Ts,c=20+5625(.010)=76.25°C

Common Mistake / શરતો

Wall drop check188.75−76.25=112.5°C=5625(.020).દરેક nodeનું temperature ઓળખાવો.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Incident radiant energy can be absorbed, reflected or transmitted. Define absorptivityalpha, reflectivityrho and transmissivitytau for the same incident conditions:alpha+rho+tau=1.

Understand why

For an opaque surface, tau=0 andalpha+rho=1.A black body absorbs all incident radiation(alpha=1) and is an ideal maximum emitter. A grey body has wavelength-independent emissivity over the band/model being assumed.

Common mistake / conditions

“Grey” is an ideal spectral model, not the surface paint colour; transparent behaviour depends on wavelength.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Incident radiant energy absorb,reflect કે transmit થાય.Same incident conditions માટે absorptivity alpha,reflectivity rho,transmissivity tau define કરીએ:alpha+rho+tau=1.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Opaque surfaceમાં tau=0,alpha+rho=1.Black body બધું incident radiation absorb કરે(alpha=1),ideal maximum emitter છે.Grey bodyમાં assumed band/modelમાં emissivity wavelength-independent છે.

Common Mistake / શરતો

“Grey” ideal spectral model છે,paintનો colour નહિ;transparency wavelength પર આધારિત છે.

h.en: 1.2.2 Emissive power, emissivity and net exchange

body.en:
Definition / principle

Emissive powerE is emitted radiant energy rate per area. Emissivityepsilon=E/Eblack at the same temperature; Eblack=sigma T⁴ withsigma=5.670374419×10^-8W/(m²·K⁴).

Understand why

A small diffuse-grey surface in large isothermal surroundings with view factor1 has ideal net exchangeQdot=epsilon sigma A(Ts⁴−Tsur⁴).For two finite surfaces, geometry/view factors and both surface properties matter.

Common mistake / conditions

Under the corresponding thermal-equilibrium/spectral conditions Kirchhoff law relates emissivity and absorptivity; do not assume totalalpha=epsilon for any arbitrary incident spectrum.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Emissive power E emitted radiant energy rate per area છે.Same temperature પર emissivity epsilon=E/Eblack;Eblack=sigma T⁴,sigma=5.670374419×10^-8W/(m²·K⁴).

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Large isothermal surroundingsમાં view factor1વાળી small diffuse-grey surface માટે ideal net exchange Qdot=epsilon sigma A(Ts⁴−Tsur⁴).બે finite surfacesમાં geometry/view factors,બન્ને properties જોઈએ.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Corresponding thermal-equilibrium/spectral conditionsમાં Kirchhoff law emissivity,absorptivity જોડે;arbitrary incident spectrumમાં total alpha=epsilon ન માનો.

body.en:
Given and model

epsilon.8, A2m², Ts500K, Tsur300K; small surface, large surrounding enclosure.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Qdot=.8×5.670374419×10^-8×2×(500⁴−300⁴)
  2. Qdot=4935.4939W≈4.935kW

Common mistake / conditions

The temperatures are absoluteK; substituting°C into a fourth-power law gives the wrong physics.

Can radiation occur through a vacuum?

Yes. It does not require a material medium.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

epsilon.8,A2m²,Ts500K,Tsur300K;small surface,large surrounding enclosure.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. Qdot=.8×5.670374419×10^-8×2×(500⁴−300⁴)
  2. Qdot=4935.4939W≈4.935kW

Common Mistake / શરતો

Temperatures absolute Kમાં છે;fourth-power lawમાં °C મૂકવાથી physics ખોટું બને.

Vacuumમાં Radiation થાય?

હા.Material medium જરૂરી નથી.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Thermal insulation reduces unwanted heat transfer using suitable material/structure. The full system may include cladding, vapour barrier, fixings and protected joints.

Understand why

Useful properties include lowk at service temperature, temperature/fire compatibility, moisture resistance, mechanical stability, chemical compatibility and safe installation/maintenance.

Classify by temperature duty(hot/cold), structure(fibrous, cellular, granular/reflective) and material family(inorganic/organic).Examples:qualified mineral wool, glass wool, calcium silicate, cellular glass and suitable polymer foams.

Common mistake / conditions

Do not recommend asbestos for routine use; dust/fire and health hazards need approved material choices. Cold insulation needs vapour control; wet insulation often performs poorly.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Thermal insulation યોગ્ય material/structureથી unwanted heat transfer ઘટાડે.Full systemમાં cladding,vapour barrier,fixings,protected joints પણ આવે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Useful properties:service temperature પર low k,temperature/fire compatibility,moisture resistance,mechanical stability,chemical compatibility,safe installation/maintenance.

Temperature duty(hot/cold),structure(fibrous,cellular,granular/reflective),material family(inorganic/organic)થી classify કરો.ઉદાહરણ:qualified mineral wool,glass wool,calcium silicate,cellular glass,suitable polymer foams.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Routine use માટે asbestos recommend ન કરો;dust/fire,health hazards માટે approved choices લો.Cold insulationમાં vapour control જોઈએ;wet insulation ઘણીવાર ખરાબ કામ કરે.

h.en: 1.2.5 Choosing thickness is not only choosing lowest k
h.gu: 1.2.5 Thickness પસંદગી ફક્ત Lowest k નહિ

body.en:
Understand why

Calculate system resistance and expected energy saving, then consider surface safety, condensation, fire rating, space, weatherproofing, maintenance and life-cycle cost.

For a cylinder, adding insulation also increases outside convection area. The ideal critical radiusrcrit=k/h under constantk, h shows why adding a very thin layer does not universally reduce heat loss.

Common mistake / conditions

Critical radius is a supporting concept, not an instruction to remove pipe insulation or ignore radiation/temperature-dependent properties.
body.gu:
કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

System resistance,expected energy saving ગણો;પછી surface safety,condensation,fire rating,space,weatherproofing,maintenance,life-cycle cost જુઓ.

Cylinderમાં insulation ઉમેરવાથી outside convection area પણ વધે.Constant k,hના ideal modelમાં critical radius rcrit=k/h બતાવે છે કે બહુ પાતળું layer ઉમેરવાથી હંમેશાં heat loss ઘટે નહિ.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Critical radius supporting concept છે;pipe insulation કાઢવાની કે radiation/temperature dependence અવગણવાની instruction નહિ.

h.en: 1.3.1 Heat exchanger:energy passes, streams need not mix
h.gu: 1.3.1 Heat Exchangerમાં Energy જાય,Streams ભળે જરૂરી નહિ

body.en:
Start with the situation

A process cools hot oil with water. We want useful transfer without contaminating the oil.

Definition / principle

A heat exchanger transfers energy between streams at different temperatures; in an indirect exchanger a wall separates them.

Understand why

Classify by contact(direct/indirect), flow(parallel, counter, cross), construction(double-pipe, shell-and-tube, plate) and phase change(condensing/evaporating/sensible).

Application / illustration

Condensers recover steam heat; oil coolers remove sensible heat; plate exchangers suit many clean-fluid duties within material/rating limits.

Common mistake / conditions

Direct contact mixes streams; do not draw a separating wall and call that direct contact.
body.gu:
પરિસ્થિતિથી શરૂઆત

Processમાં hot oilને waterથી ઠંડું કરીએ.Oil contaminate કર્યા વગર useful transfer જોઈએ.

Definition / Principle

Heat exchanger જુદા temperaturesના streams વચ્ચે energy transfer કરે;indirect exchangerમાં wall જુદા પાડે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Contact(direct/indirect),flow(parallel,counter,cross),construction(double-pipe,shell-and-tube,plate),phase change(condensing/evaporating/sensible)થી classify કરો.

Application / ઉદાહરણ

Condensers steam heat કાઢે;oil coolers sensible heat દૂર કરે;plate exchangers material/rating limitsમાં અનેક clean-fluid dutiesમાં કામ આવે.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Direct contactમાં streams mix થાય;separating wall દોરીને direct contact ન કહો.

body.en:
Definition / principle

One fluid passes inside a tube, the other through the annular passage; connections determine parallel/counter flow.

Construction:part and purpose

Inner tube provides the separating heat-transfer wall.

Outer pipe forms an annular second passage.

Inlet/outlet connections set flow arrangement and prevent unintended mixing.

Supports, seals, temperature/flow measurement points complete a rated installation.

Working:flow and reason

Trace both streams independently and identify inlet/outlet temperatures.

Maintain the specified flow and pressure conditions through authorised controls.

Heat crosses fluid films and the tube wall due to local temperature difference.

Apply energy balance and the correct mean temperature difference to evaluate duty.

Common mistake / conditions

The annular area is a flow area; it is not automatically the heat-transfer surface area used withU.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

એક fluid inner tubeમાં,બીજું annular passageમાં જાય;connections parallel/counter flow નક્કી કરે.

Construction:ભાગ અને કામ

Inner tube separating heat-transfer wall આપે.

Outer pipe annular second passage બનાવે.

Inlet/outlet connections flow arrangement આપે,unintended mixing અટકાવે.

Supports,seals,temperature/flow points rated installation પૂરી કરે.

Working:Flow અને કારણ

બન્ને streams અલગ trace કરી inlet/outlet temperatures ઓળખો.

Authorised controlsથી specified flow,pressure conditions જાળવો.

Local temperature differenceથી fluid films,tube wall પાર heat જાય.

Duty માટે energy balance,યોગ્ય mean temperature difference લો.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Annular area flow area છે;U સાથેનું heat-transfer surface area આપમેળે એ નથી.

body.en:
Understand why

Shell-and-tube:a tube bundle in a shell with tube sheets, heads and suitable baffles; one stream inside tubes, the other outside. Baffles guide shell flow/support tubes but add pressure drop.

Plate exchanger:thin corrugated plates form alternating channels; gaskets/brazing/welding isolate streams. Suitable construction gives compact high area but fouling, cleaning, pressure and compatibility limits matter.

Common mistake / conditions

Selection must consider duty, temperature approach, pressure drop, fouling, cleanability, leak consequences and material/rating—not only compactness.
body.gu:
કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Shell-and-tubeમાં shellની અંદર tube bundle,tube sheets,heads,suitable baffles હોય;એક stream tubesમાં,બીજું બહાર.Baffles shell flow guide/tubes support કરે,પણ pressure drop વધે.

Plate exchangerમાં thin corrugated plates alternating channels બનાવે;gaskets/brazing/welding streams જુદા રાખે.Compact high area મળે,પણ fouling,cleaning,pressure,compatibility limits જોઈએ.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Selectionમાં duty,temperature approach,pressure drop,fouling,cleanability,leak consequences,material/rating જુઓ,ફક્ત compactness નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A tube bundle separates two pressure-rated streams; the shell path may use baffles and multiple passes.

Construction:part and purpose

Tube sheets secure/seal tube ends; heads or water boxes distribute tube-side flow.

Shell encloses the second stream and supports inlet/outlet nozzles.

Baffles/supports guide shell flow and limit tube vibration within the design.

Expansion provisions, seals, drains and inspection access suit thermal stress and maintenance.

Working:flow and reason

One stream enters the tube head and follows the selected tube passes.

The other enters the shell and crosses/flows along the bundle as designed.

Heat crosses the tube-side film, metal wall and shell-side film.

Streams leave separately; measure temperatures/flows to evaluate duty, pressure drop and fouling.

Common mistake / conditions

A tube leak can cause cross-contamination according to pressure difference; isolating/repairing pressure equipment requires approved procedures.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Tube bundle બે pressure-rated streams જુદા રાખે;shell pathમાં baffles,multiple passes હોઈ શકે.

Construction:ભાગ અને કામ

Tube sheets tube ends secure/seal કરે;heads/water boxes tube-side flow distribute કરે.

Shell second streamને ઘેરે,inlet/outlet nozzles આપે.

Baffles/supports shell flow guide,tube vibration designમાં limit કરે.

Expansion provisions,seals,drains,inspection access thermal stress,maintenance માટે હોય.

Working:Flow અને કારણ

એક stream tube headમાં આવી selected tube passesમાં જાય.

બીજું shellમાં આવી bundleને designed રીતે cross/along જાય.

Heat tube-side film,metal wall,shell-side film પાર જાય.

Streams અલગ જાય;duty,pressure drop,fouling માટે temperatures/flows માપો.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Tube leakમાં pressure difference મુજબ cross-contamination થાય;pressure equipment isolation/repairમાં approved procedure જોઈએ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Alternating narrow channels exchange heat across plates without intended mixing.

Construction:part and purpose

Corrugated plates supply area and promote flow mixing within each channel.

Gaskets, brazed or welded joints separate the two circuits according to construction.

Ports/manifolds route alternating hot and cold channels.

Frame/pressure plates or the sealed assembly withstand the rated forces.

Working:flow and reason

Hot/cold streams enter their assigned ports.

Distribution sends them through alternate passages, commonly near-counterflow.

Heat passes through thin plates while separate pressure circuits remain.

Outlet streams leave through separate ports; cleaning strategy depends on gasketed/brazed/welded construction.

Common mistake / conditions

Narrow passages can foul/block; gasket compatibility, pressure differential and cleaning access control application.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Alternating narrow channels plates પાર heat exchange કરે,intended mixing વગર.

Construction:ભાગ અને કામ

Corrugated plates area,દરેક channelમાં flow mixing આપે.

Gaskets,brazed/welded joints construction મુજબ circuits જુદા રાખે.

Ports/manifolds alternating hot/cold channelsમાં flow આપે.

Frame/pressure plates કે sealed assembly rated forces લે.

Working:Flow અને કારણ

Hot/cold streams assigned portsમાં આવે.

Distribution alternate passagesમાં,ઘણીવાર near-counterflowમાં મોકલે.

Separate pressure circuitsમાં thin plates પાર heat જાય.

Outlet streams અલગ portsથી જાય;cleaning strategy construction પર આધારિત છે.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Narrow passages foul/block થાય;gasket compatibility,pressure difference,cleaning access application નક્કી કરે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

For a well-insulated steady exchanger with negligible work/kinetic changes:Qdot=mhot(hhi−hho)=mcold(hco−hci).For constantcp without phase change usemcp Delta T.

Understand why

Qdot=UA Delta Tlm for the stated ideal arrangement; U combines film, wall and specified fouling resistances on one consistent area basis. A real multipass/crossflow design may require correction factorF:Qdot=UAF Delta Tlm.

Common mistake / conditions

Do not confuse conductivityk, convection coefficienth and overall coefficientU.Their meanings and units differ.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Well-insulated steady exchangerમાં negligible work/kinetic changes હોય તો Qdot=mhot(hhi−hho)=mcold(hco−hci).Phase change વગર constant cpમાં mcp Delta T લો.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Stated ideal arrangementમાં Qdot=UA Delta Tlm;Uમાં film,wall,specified fouling resistances એક consistent area basis પર જોડાય.Real multipass/crossflowમાં correction factor Fથી Qdot=UAF Delta Tlm જોઈએ.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Conductivity k,convection h,overall U ભેળવો નહિ;અર્થ,units જુદાં છે.

h.en: 1.3.7 LMTD:pair temperatures at the same end

body.en:
Definition / principle

Delta Tlm=(Delta T1−Delta T2)/ln(Delta T1/Delta T2).For equal positive end differences, the limiting value is that common difference.

Understand why

Parallel flow:Delta T1=Thi−Tci, Delta T2=Tho−Tco. Counterflow:Delta T1=Thi−Tco, Delta T2=Tho−Tci. Draw physical ends before substituting.

Common mistake / conditions

Do not substitute a negative temperature difference into this simple logarithmic form; check physical feasibility and the flow model first.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Delta Tlm=(Delta T1−Delta T2)/ln(Delta T1/Delta T2).બન્ને positive end differences સરખાં હોય તો limiting value એ common difference છે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Parallel flow:Delta T1=Thi−Tci,Delta T2=Tho−Tco.Counterflow:Delta T1=Thi−Tco,Delta T2=Tho−Tci.Substitution પહેલાં physical ends દોરો.

Common Mistake / શરતો

આ simple logarithmic formમાં negative difference ન મૂકો;પહેલાં physical feasibility,flow model જુઓ.

body.en:
Given and model

Hot fluid150→90°C, cold20→70°C; hotm1kg/s, cp2kJ/(kg·K); U500W/(m²·K), ideal counterflow, F1.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Qdot=1×2×(150−90)=120kW
  2. Delta T1=150−70=80K; Delta T2=90−20=70K
  3. Delta Tlm=(80−70)/ln(80/70)=74.8888K
  4. A=120000/(500×74.8888)=3.20475m²

Common mistake / conditions

The cold-side heat-capacity ratemcp required by balance is120/50=2.4kW/K; terminal temperatures alone do not specify both mass flows.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

Hot fluid150→90°C,cold20→70°C;hot m1kg/s,cp2kJ/(kg·K);U500W/(m²·K),ideal counterflow,F1.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. Qdot=1×2×(150−90)=120kW
  2. Delta T1=150−70=80K;Delta T2=90−20=70K
  3. Delta Tlm=(80−70)/ln(80/70)=74.8888K
  4. A=120000/(500×74.8888)=3.20475m²

Common Mistake / શરતો

Balance મુજબ cold-side heat-capacity rate mcp120/50=2.4kW/K જોઈએ;ફક્ત terminal temperaturesથી બન્ને mass flows નક્કી નથી થતા.

h.en: 1.3.9 Parallel flow comparison at the same terminal temperatures
h.gu: 1.3.9 Same Terminal Temperaturesમાં Parallel Flowની સરખામણી

body.en:
Given and model

Use the preceding hot150→90°C, cold20→70°C, duty120kW, U500W/(m²·K), but parallel flow, F1.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Delta T1=150−20=130K; Delta T2=90−70=20K
  2. LMTD=(130−20)/ln(130/20)=58.7669K
  3. Area=120000/(500×58.7669)=4.08393m²

Common mistake / conditions

For these feasible terminal conditions, the parallel-flow area exceeds the3.20475m² counterflow area for the same duty, U andF.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

પહેલાંના hot150→90°C,cold20→70°C,duty120kW,U500W/(m²·K) લો,પણ parallel flow,F1.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. Delta T1=150−20=130K;Delta T2=90−70=20K
  2. LMTD=(130−20)/ln(130/20)=58.7669K
  3. Area=120000/(500×58.7669)=4.08393m²

Common Mistake / શરતો

આ feasible terminal conditionsમાં same duty,U,F માટે parallel area3.20475m² counterflow area કરતાં વધુ છે.

body.en:
Write a strong exam answer

  1. Draw the heat path; label temperatures and areas; state steady/one-dimensional/constant-property assumptions; choose resistance or energy balance; substitute with units; check sign and conservation.
  2. For an exchanger answer add flow arrows, construction parts, working, application, fouling/pressure-drop limitations and correct terminal pairing. No derivations are required for the listed wall/cylinder/LMTD formulas.
Can the counterflow cold outlet exceed the hot outlet?

Yes, under a physically feasible energy balance; it still cannot exceed the hot inlet in this passive sensible model.
body.gu:
Exam Answer મજબૂત ગોઠવીએ

  1. Heat path દોરો;temperatures,areas label કરો;steady/one-dimensional/constant-property assumptions આપો;resistance/energy balance લો;unitsથી substitute કરો;sign,conservation તપાસો.
  2. Exchanger answerમાં flow arrows,Construction,Working,Application,fouling/pressure-drop limits,correct terminal pairing ઉમેરો.Listed wall/cylinder/LMTD formulasની derivations જરૂરી નથી.
Counterflowમાં Cold Outlet,Hot Outlet કરતાં ગરમ હોઈ શકે?

હા,physically feasible balanceમાં;પણ આ passive sensible modelમાં hot inletથી ઉપર નહિ.
